collection.title: Ford S-Max 2015 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford S-Max 2015 - 2018 model requires a 30" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this S-Max which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
